### Summary

If a dialog is long, that means it gets a scrollbar at the right hand side, it always starts at the bottom, so the user has to scroll up to see first entries.

### 🔬 Reproduction App Available

I've created a reproduction app for this issue:

[![Open in Streamlit](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/gh-12716)

**Direct link:** https://issues.streamlitapp.com/gh-12716

The issue has been confirmed. Note that the bug appears when **reopening** the dialog (not on first open), so try closing and reopening the dialog to see it.

### Workaround

Until this is fixed, you can work around the issue by using `st.rerun()` to reset the scroll position:

```python
[USER].dialog("My Dialog")
def my_dialog():
    # Your dialog content
    if st.button("Close and Reset"):
        st.rerun()  # This will reset scroll position
```
Closing this since it was fixed with the migration from basweb to react-aria.
